agent_events_report_window.name: agent_events_report_window
agent_events_report_window.where: data->>'report' is not null or data->>'from' = 'agent'

map_returns_given_back.name: map_returns_given_back
map_returns_given_back.value: ("map_returns"."returned_at" IS NULL) = ("map_returns"."returned_epoch" IS NULL) AND ("map_returns"."returned_at" IS NULL) = ("map_returns"."source_key" IS NULL)

model_check_evaluations_clean_pass.name: model_check_evaluations_clean_pass
model_check_evaluations_clean_pass.value: "model_check_evaluations"."status" <> 'passed' OR ("model_check_evaluations"."complete" AND "model_check_evaluations"."infra_errors" = 0 AND "model_check_evaluations"."must_block_misses" = 0 AND "model_check_evaluations"."metrics" IS NOT NULL AND "model_check_evaluations"."holdout_metrics" IS NOT NULL)

model_checks_on_is_bound.name: model_checks_on_is_bound
model_checks_on_is_bound.value: "model_checks"."status" = 'off' OR ("model_checks"."binding_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "model_checks"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL AND "model_checks"."thresholds" IS NOT NULL AND "model_checks"."off_reason" IS NULL)

proposals_material_stamp.name: proposals_material_stamp
proposals_material_stamp.value:
("proposals"."material_revision" IS NULL AND "proposals"."material_digest" IS NULL) OR
  ("proposals"."material_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "proposals"."material_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "proposals"."material_revision" > 0
   AND "proposals"."material_revision" <= 9007199254740991 AND "proposals"."material_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

requests_material_stamp.name: requests_material_stamp
requests_material_stamp.value:
("requests"."material_revision" IS NULL AND "requests"."material_digest" IS NULL) OR
  ("requests"."material_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "requests"."material_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "requests"."material_revision" > 0
   AND "requests"."material_revision" <= 9007199254740991 AND "requests"."material_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

requests_approval_commit.name: requests_approval_commit
requests_approval_commit.value: "requests"."kind" <> 'approval' OR "requests"."commit" IS NOT NULL OR "requests"."approval_channel" IS NOT NULL

task_waits_counts.name: task_waits_counts
task_waits_counts.value: "task_waits"."source_revision" >= 0 AND "task_waits"."generation" >= 1 AND "task_waits"."review_ordinal" >= 0 AND "task_waits"."route_revision" >= 0 AND "task_waits"."level" BETWEEN 0 AND 3

task_waits_active_is_whole.name: task_waits_active_is_whole
task_waits_active_is_whole.value:
"task_waits"."state" <> 'active' OR (
    ("task_waits"."owner_agent_id" IS NULL) <> ("task_waits"."owner_person_id" IS NULL) AND "task_waits"."plan" IS NOT NULL AND "task_waits"."owner_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "task_waits"."head_due_at" IS NOT NULL
    AND "task_waits"."decision_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "task_waits"."next_action_at" IS NOT NULL)

task_waits_reviews_go_on.name: task_waits_reviews_go_on
task_waits_reviews_go_on.value: "task_waits"."state" <> 'active' OR "task_waits"."next_review_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("task_waits"."review_ordinal" >= 1 AND "task_waits"."kind" = 'external' AND "task_waits"."source_key" LIKE 'operation:%')

task_waits_legacy_has_no_dates.name: task_waits_legacy_has_no_dates
task_waits_legacy_has_no_dates.value: "task_waits"."state" <> 'legacy_needs_plan' OR ("task_waits"."plan" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."owner_due_at" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."head_due_at" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."decision_due_at" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."next_action_at" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."next_review_at" IS NULL)

task_waits_ended.name: task_waits_ended
task_waits_ended.value: ("task_waits"."state" IN ('active', 'legacy_needs_plan')) = ("task_waits"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."outcome" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."proof_ref" IS NULL)

tasks_closed_at.name: tasks_closed_at
tasks_closed_at.value: "tasks"."status" NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled') OR "tasks"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL

test_runs_environment_request.name: test_runs_environment_request
test_runs_environment_request.where: "test_runs"."environment_request" is not null and "test_runs"."environment_snapshot" is null and "test_runs"."status" = 'running'

wait_notices_wait_whole.name: wait_notices_wait_whole
wait_notices_wait_whole.value: "wait_notices"."wait_id" IS NULL OR ("wait_notices"."generation" IS NOT NULL AND "wait_notices"."level" IS NOT NULL AND "wait_notices"."purpose" IS NOT NULL AND "wait_notices"."route_revision" IS NOT NULL)
